activities.title: Which pile has more
activities.intro: Two piles are on the screen. Look at both piles. Tap the pile that has more.
activities.offScreen: Go make two piles of your toys, a big pile and a small pile, and show a grown-up which pile has more.

rounds.prompt: Two piles of flowers. Tap the pile with more flowers.
Two piles of fish. Tap the pile with more fish.
Two piles of blocks. Tap the pile with more blocks.
Two piles of stars. Tap the pile with more stars.

activities.title: Count to check
activities.intro: Your eyes picked the bigger pile. Now count it to check. Tap how many.
activities.offScreen: At dinner, count out loud how many spoons are on the table, one number for each spoon.

rounds.prompt: Two piles of leaves. Find the pile with more, then count it. How many leaves are in the bigger pile?
Two piles of coins. Find the pile with more, then count it. How many coins are in the bigger pile?
Two piles of cups. Find the pile with more, then count it. How many cups are in the bigger pile?
Two piles of birds. Find the pile with more, then count it. How many birds are in the bigger pile?

activities.title: Which pile has fewer
activities.intro: Now the tricky one. Tap the pile that has fewer, the smaller pile.
activities.offScreen: At snack time, ask who has fewer bites left, you or your grown-up.

rounds.prompt: Two piles of blocks. Tap the pile with fewer blocks.
Two piles of birds. Tap the pile with fewer birds.
Two piles of coins. Tap the pile with fewer coins.
Two piles of flowers. Look closely. Tap the pile with fewer flowers.

parentCard.title: Tower night
steps: Build one tower together to warm up, then each of you builds your own tower.
Ask: whose tower has more blocks? Guess first, just by looking.
Count each tower out loud together, one number for one block, to check the guess.
Take two blocks off the taller tower and ask: now who has more?
notice: Do they guess more or fewer by looking before they count?
Do they count each block exactly once, one number for one block?
Do they ever use the words more and fewer on their own?
